name: Community naloxone distribution and overdose-response outreach
appliesWhen: The marginal gift buys additional naloxone doses delivered to people likely to witness or experience opioid overdose (street outreach, syringe services, drop-in, mail-based distribution).
The organization reports doses distributed and reversals reported for a recent period.
doesNotApplyWhen: Funding pays for overdose prevention sites, treatment (use medications-for-opioid-use-disorder), or policy advocacy.
The organization reports people reached but neither doses nor reversals; use a population-reach variant instead (see localization-test.md, Chicago Recovery Alliance).

nativeOutcome.notes: Counts acute survivals that would not otherwise have occurred. Reported reversals are an output, not this outcome.

qalyBridge.notes: Continuous-time discounted survival with a constant all-cause hazard, truncated at horizonYears. Swap this bridge to test different survivor-life assumptions without touching the native estimate.

costPerDose.label: Donor cost per additional dose delivered

preferredSources: Public contract or grant budget with dose targets for this organization
State or county naloxone program budget divided by doses
Executed program expense divided by doses (average, then adjust upward for expansion)
lookup.fallback: Wholesale price of the dominant formulation plus outreach labor, labeled judgment.
lookup.judgmentGuide: SF central $20 = roughly 2x a $9.61 planned bundle/target-dose benchmark, allowing extra outreach effort and shortfalls. If the state supplies drug free, cost is outreach labor only.

reportedReversals.label: Reversals reported by the organization in the reference year

preferredSources: Organization annual report or service page
State overdose-education and naloxone-distribution (OEND) program reports
lookup.fallback: None. Without a reversal count, this template does not apply.

reportedDoses.label: Doses distributed by the organization in the same year

preferredSources: Same document as reportedReversals, same year
lookup.fallback: None. Do not mix years between numerator and denominator.

marginalYieldRetention.label: Share of reported reversal yield retained at the margin

preferredSources: Local saturation evidence: doses per person who uses opioids, public distribution volume, number of competing distributors
lookup.fallback: Copy the SF distribution and flag as transferred judgment.
lookup.judgmentGuide: SF 0.25/0.5/0.75 combines harder-to-reach expansion, displacement, reporting mismatch and repeat recipients. Lower it where public distribution is already saturated.

additionalSurvivalPerReversal.label: Additional acute survivals per retained reversal

preferredSources: Local EMS response times and bystander-naloxone prevalence
Local fentanyl share of overdose deaths
lookup.fallback: Copy SF distribution, flag as transferred judgment.
lookup.judgmentGuide: SF 0.005/0.02/0.05: most reported reversals are assumed not to be lives saved because of spontaneous survival and alternative rescue.

default.rationale: Downward transfer from 0.799 for HIV-negative daily heroin injection, allowing comorbidity and population differences.

sources.publisher: Patton et al., Quality of Life Research
sources.title: Analyzing quality of life among people with opioid use disorder from the NIDA Data Share initiative

annualHazard.label: Annual all-cause mortality hazard after a nonfatal overdose

default.rationale: Central informed by 778.3 deaths per 10,000 person-years in a US overdose-survivor cohort. Note: a higher hazard lowers QALYs, so p90 here is the pessimistic case.

sources.title: Causes of Death After Nonfatal Opioid Overdose

sources.publisher: Weiner et al., Annals of Emergency Medicine
sources.title: One-Year Mortality of Patients After Emergency Department Treatment for Nonfatal Opioid Overdose

default.rationale: Truncates benefits because recipient ages and long-term outcomes are unknown; not a life expectancy.

excludedEffects: Drug supplied free by public programs (counted only if the gift pays for it)
nullBoundary: If the gift replaces existing provision or reaches no otherwise-fatal events, deaths averted are zero and there is no finite price.

origin.reproduces: At all p50 inputs with SFAF 2025 reported reversals/doses, reproduces the SF central $56,328 per 10 QALYs exactly. Change: the three joint scenarios become per-parameter p10/p50/p90, so the simulator mixes them independently instead of as fixed corners.
